description: This is the main entry point for the rusefi project, acting as a command-line interface that registers and invokes various tools related to PCB and BOM processing. It maps tool names to classes and dynamically calls their main methods based on user input.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Main class that acts as a CLI front-end to invoke various tools based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: registerTool
methods.description: Registers a tool class with a given name into the TOOLS map.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main method that processes command-line arguments to invoke the appropriate tool's main method.
